## Activity

During December 2025, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 78 captures. This activity provides the overall volume for the reporting period and forms the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results subsequently identified as referable.

## Image quality

The ungradable rate was 3.8 per cent, representing 3 captures. This indicates that most captures were available for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the usual support process.

## Grading

A total of 15 results were graded referable during the period. The median grading lag was 2. This provides a summary measure of the time between capture and completion of grading. The site should continue to review grading activity with image quality and operational issues to support consistent service delivery.
